q: (Only Allaah knows the correct meaning of these letters.)
v.s: Hā, Meem.
v.c: Ḥâ-Mĩm.

q: is from Allaah, the Mighty, the Wise.
v.s: The revelation of the Book is from God, the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
v.c: The revelation of this Book is from Allah—the Almighty, All-Wise.

q: (proving the Greatness and Oneness of Allaah)
in the heavens and the earth for the Mu'mineen.
v.s: Indeed, within the heavens and earth are signs for the believers.
v.c: Surely in ˹the creation of˺ the heavens and the earth are signs for the believers.

q: there are also numerous Aayaat for those who are convinced
v.s: And in the creation of yourselves and what He disperses of moving creatures are signs for people who are certain [in faith].
v.c: And in your own creation, and whatever living beings He dispersed, are signs for people of sure faith.

q: The alternation of the night and day; the sustenance
that Allaah sends from the skies that revives the earth after its death; and the turning of the winds
are all Aayaat for people with understanding
v.s: And [in] the alternation of night and day and [in] what God sends down from the sky of provision [i.e., rain] and gives life thereby to the earth after its lifelessness and [in His] directing of the winds are signs for a people who reason.
v.c: And ˹in˺ the alternation of the day and the night, the provision sent down from the skies by Allah —reviving the earth after its death—and the shifting of the winds, are signs for people of understanding.

q: that We recite to you with the truth
So what will they believe in after
(When they fail to believe things that are so clear, how can they be expected to believe in anything else?)
v.s: These are the verses of God which We recite to you in truth. Then in what statement after God and His verses will they believe?
v.c: These are Allah’s revelations which We recite to you ˹O Prophet˺ in truth. So what message will they believe in after ˹denying˺ Allah and His revelations?

v.s: Woe to every sinful liar
v.c: Woe to every sinful liar.

q: being recited to him and then remains haughty
as if he had not heard them. Give him the good news of a painful punishment
v.s: Who hears the verses of God recited to him, then persists arrogantly as if he had not heard them. So give him tidings of a painful punishment.
v.c: They hear Allah’s revelations recited to them, then persist ˹in denial˺ arrogantly as if they did not hear them. So give them good news of a painful punishment.

q: When he learns of any of Our Aayaat, he mocks it. There shall be a humiliating
v.s: And when he knows anything of Our verses, he takes them in ridicule. Those will have a humiliating punishment.
v.c: And whenever they learn anything of Our revelations, they make a mockery of it. It is they who will suffer a humiliating punishment.

q: they earned will be of no benefit
to them, neither will the patrons
that they adopted besides Allaah be
(of any help to them). (There in Jahannam)
They shall suffer a terrible punishment.
v.s: Before them is Hell, and what they had earned will not avail them at all nor what they had taken besides God as allies. And they will have a great punishment.
v.c: Awaiting them is Hell. Their ˹worldly˺ gains will not be of any benefit to them whatsoever, nor will those protectors they have taken besides Allah. And they will suffer a tremendous punishment.

q: (and those who follow its guidance will be greatly rewarded in Jannah),
there awaits a painful punishment of immense
proportions for those who disbelieve the Aayaat of their Rabb.
v.s: This [Qur’ān] is guidance. And those who have disbelieved in the verses of their Lord will have a painful punishment of foul nature.
v.c: This ˹Quran˺ is ˹true˺ guidance. And those who deny their Lord’s revelations will suffer the ˹worst˺ torment of agonizing pain.

q: the oceans at your service so that
ships may travel on them by His command, so that you may seek
from His bounty, and so that you may express gratitude
(to Him for these bounties thus recognise Allah's rights).
v.s: It is God who subjected to you the sea so that ships may sail upon it by His command and that you may seek of His bounty; and perhaps you will be grateful.
v.c: Allah is the One Who has subjected the sea for you so that ships may sail upon it by His command, and that you may seek His bounty, and that perhaps you will be grateful.

q: Allaah has also placed at your service
everything in the heavens and everything on earth. There are definitely Aayaat
v.s: And He has subjected to you whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth - all from Him. Indeed in that are signs for a people who give thought.
v.c: He ˹also˺ subjected for you whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth—all by His grace. Surely in this are signs for people who reflect.

q: Tell those who have Imaan that they should pardon
those who do not look forward to Allaah's days
(the time when Allaah will reward and punish people)
(they may reap rewards for this and)
Allaah may repay every nation for what
v.s: Say, [O Muhammad], to those who have believed that they [should] forgive those who expect not the days of God [i.e., of His retribution] so that He may recompense a people for what they used to earn.
v.c: ˹O Prophet!˺ Tell the believers to forgive those who do not fear Allah’s days ˹of torment˺, so that He will reward each group for what they used to commit.

m: then it is for his soul
q: Whoever does a good deed does so for his own benefit, and whoever commits a sin does so to his own detriment
(because only he alone will suffer the punishment for his sins).
You will all be returned to your Rabb shortly
(and He will reward or punish you accordingly).
v.s: Whoever does a good deed - it is for himself; and whoever does evil - it is against it [i.e., the self or soul]. Then to your Lord you will be returned.
v.c: Whoever does good, it is to their own benefit. And whoever does evil, it is to their own loss. Then to your Lord you will ˹all˺ be returned.

q: Verily We gave the Bani Israa'eel the Book
and granted them excellence over the
v.s: And We did certainly give the Children of Israel the Scripture and judgement and prophethood, and We provided them with good things and preferred them over the worlds.
v.c: Indeed, We gave the Children of Israel the Scripture, wisdom, and prophethood; granted them good, lawful provisions; and favoured them above the others.

q: We also gave them clear proofs
of religion. They differed only after knowledge
came to them because of enmity
between themselves. Indeed your Rabb shall judge between them on the Day of Qiyaamah concerning the differences they had.
v.s: And We gave them clear proofs of the matter [of religion]. And they did not differ except after knowledge had come to them - out of jealous animosity between themselves. Indeed, your Lord will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection concerning that over which they used to differ.
v.c: We ˹also˺ gave them clear commandments regarding ˹their˺ faith. But it was not until knowledge came to them that they differed out of mutual envy. Surely your Lord will judge between them on the Day of Judgment regarding their differences.

q: (after all these nations had passed on)
and do not follow the whims
of those who have no knowledge
(do not follow the Kuffaar who want you to give up propagation and therefore continue to harass you).
v.s: Then We put you, [O Muhammad], on an ordained way concerning the matter [of religion]; so follow it and do not follow the inclinations of those who do not know.
v.c: Now We have set you ˹O Prophet˺ on the ˹clear˺ Way of faith. So follow it, and do not follow the desires of those who do not know ˹the truth˺.

q: (if you follow them and thereby incur Allaah's punishment,)
will never be of any use to you against
of each other and Allaah is a Protecting Friend to the people with Taqwa.
v.s: Indeed, they will never avail you against God at all. And indeed, the wrongdoers are allies of one another; but God is the protector of the righteous.
v.c: They certainly can be of no benefit to you against Allah whatsoever. Surely the wrongdoers are patrons of each other, whereas Allah is the Patron of the righteous.

q: guidance and mercy for people with conviction
v.s: This [Qur’ān] is enlightenment for mankind and guidance and mercy for a people who are certain [in faith].
v.c: This ˹Quran˺ is an insight for humanity—a guide and mercy for people of sure faith.

q: who commit sins think that We will treat them
those who have Imaan and who do good deeds, making the lives and deaths
(They will find out when they die and on the Day of Qiyaamah that their plight will be a pitiful one indeed, whereas the Mu'mineen will enjoy bliss and comfort.)
v.s: Or do those who commit evils think We will make them like those who have believed and done righteous deeds - [make them] equal in their life and their death? Evil is that which they judge [i.e., assume].
v.c: Or do those who commit evil deeds ˹simply˺ think that We will make them equal—in their life and after their death—to those who believe and do good? How wrong is their judgment!
v.h: Good and Evil Are Not Equal

q: Allaah has created the heavens and the earth with the truth
(people may realise that the Being Who created everything can certainly resurrect people on the Day of Qiyaamah when)
every soul may be recompensed for what it does, and people will not be oppressed.
v.s: And God created the heavens and earth in truth and so that every soul may be recompensed for what it has earned, and they will not be wronged.
v.c: For Allah created the heavens and the earth for a purpose, so that every soul may be paid back for what it has committed. And none will be wronged.

m: and Allah lets him go astray
and Allah lets him go astray
q: Have you seen the one who has taken his whims as a Ilaah
(who follows the dictates of his desires);
whom Allaah has allowed to stray despite
ears and heart Allaah has sealed and on whose
eyes Allaah has cast a veil
(because of his incessant kufr and sins, he has been spiritually handicapped and is therefore unable to accept the truth)?
Who can guide him after Allaah? Will you not take heed
(and mend your ways before such a handicap restrains your spiritual faculties as well)?
v.s: Have you seen he who has taken as his god his [own] desire, and God has sent him astray due to knowledge and has set a seal upon his hearing and his heart and put over his vision a veil? So who will guide him after God? Then will you not be reminded?
v.c: Have you seen ˹O Prophet˺ those who have taken their own desires as their god? ˹And so˺ Allah left them to stray knowingly, sealed their hearing and hearts, and placed a cover on their sight. Who then can guide them after Allah? Will you ˹all˺ not then be mindful?

q: say, “This is nothing but our worldly life
(after which there will be no other life).
We live and die and it is only time that will destroy us
(we die only because our bodily functions deteriorate with age).”
They have no proof for this but only speculate
(because there are many who die long before old age).
v.s: And they say, "There is not but our worldly life; we die and live, and nothing destroys us except time." And they have of that no knowledge; they are only assuming.
v.c: And they argue, “There is nothing beyond our worldly life. We die; others are born. And nothing destroys us but ˹the passage of˺ time.” Yet they have no knowledge ˹in support˺ of this ˹claim˺. They only speculate.
v.h: Arguments of the Deniers of Resurrection

q: When Our clear Aayaat are recited to them
the only argument they can present is to say, “Bring forth our forefathers if you are truthful.”
v.s: And when Our verses are recited to them as clear evidences, their argument is only that they say, "Bring [back] our forefathers, if you should be truthful."
v.c: And whenever Our clear revelations are recited to them, their only argument is to say: “Bring our forefathers back, if what you say is true!”

q: “(I have no power to do this because when He willed)
will then gather you all for the Day of Qiyaamah about which there is no doubt. However most people do not know
(this and choose rather to follow untrue beliefs).”
v.s: Say, "God causes you to live, then causes you to die; then He will assemble you for the Day of Resurrection, about which there is no doubt, but most of the people do not know."
v.c: Say, ˹O Prophet,˺ “˹It is˺ Allah ˹Who˺ gives you life, then causes you to die, then will gather you ˹all˺ on the Day of Judgment, about which there is no doubt. But most people do not know.”

q: To Allaah belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth. On the day that Qiyaamah will take place, the people of falsehood
v.s: And to God belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth. And the Day the Hour appears - that Day the falsifiers will lose.
v.c: To Allah ˹alone˺ belongs the kingdom of the heavens and the earth. On the Day the Hour will be established, the people of falsehood will then be in ˹total˺ loss.

q: You will see every nation kneeling
(to plead for mercy out of terror and awe)
and every nation will be called towards their Book
(the records of their actions). (They will then be told,)
“Today you will be recompensed for what you did
v.s: And you will see every nation kneeling [from fear]. Every nation will be called to its record [and told], "Today you will be recompensed for what you used to do.
v.c: And you will see every faith-community on its knees. Every community will be summoned to its record ˹of deeds˺. ˹They all will be told,˺ “This Day you will be rewarded for what you used to do.

q: (It will be further said to them,)
is Our Book which speaks about you with the truth
Verily We used to have everything you did
v.s: This, Our record, speaks about you in truth. Indeed, We were having transcribed whatever you used to do."
v.c: This record of Ours speaks the truth about you. Indeed, We always had your deeds recorded ˹by the angels˺.”

q: As for those who have Imaan and who do good deeds, their Rabb shall enter
v.s: So as for those who believed and did righteous deeds, their Lord will admit them into His mercy. That is what is the clear attainment.
v.c: As for those who believed and did good, their Lord will admit them into His mercy. That is ˹truly˺ the absolute triumph.

q: and you were a sinful nation
v.s: But as for those who disbelieved, [it will be said], “Were not Our verses recited to you, but you were arrogant and became a people of criminals?
v.c: And as for those who disbelieved, ˹they will be told,˺ “Were My revelations not recited to you, yet you acted arrogantly and were a wicked people?

q: “When it was said that Allaah's promise is true and that there is no doubt in
Qiyaamah, you used to say, 'We do not know what Qiyaamah is. We merely give it a passing
thought but have never been convinced
v.s: And when it was said, 'Indeed, the promise of God is truth and the Hour [is coming] - no doubt about it,' you said, 'We know not what is the Hour. We assume only assumption, and we are not convinced.'"
v.c: And whenever it was said ˹to you˺, ‘Surely Allah’s promise ˹of judgment˺ is true and there is no doubt about the Hour,’ you said ˹mockingly˺, ‘We do not know what the Hour is! We think it is no more than speculation, and we are not convinced ˹that it will ever come˺.’”

q: The evil of what they do shall become evident before them and they will be surrounded
v.s: And the evil consequences of what they did will appear to them, and they will be enveloped by what they used to ridicule.
v.c: And the evil ˹consequences˺ of their deeds will unfold before them, and they will be overwhelmed by what they used to ridicule.

q: It will be said, “Today We shall forget
you just as you forgot your meeting of this day. Your abode shall be the Fire and you shall have no helpers.”
v.s: And it will be said, "Today We will forget you as you forgot the meeting of this Day of yours, and your refuge is the Fire, and for you there are no helpers.
v.c: It will be said, “This Day We will neglect you as you neglected the meeting of this Day of yours! Your home will be the Fire, and you will have no helpers.

q: “This is because you treated Allaah's Aayaat as a joke
by the life of this world.” Today they will neither be removed from the Fire nor will they be given the opportunity to please Allaah.
v.s: That is because you took the verses of God in ridicule, and worldly life deluded you." So that Day they will not be removed from it, nor will they be asked to appease [God].
v.c: This is because you made a mockery of Allah’s revelations, and were deluded by ˹your˺ worldly life.” So ˹from˺ that Day ˹on˺ they will not be taken out of the Fire, nor will they be allowed to appease ˹their Lord˺.

q: All praise belongs to Allaah, the Rabb of the heavens, the Rabb of the earth and the Rabb of the universe.
v.s: Then, to God belongs [all] praise - Lord of the heavens and Lord of the earth, Lord of the worlds.
v.c: So all praise is for Allah—Lord of the heavens and Lord of the earth, Lord of all worlds.

q: is His in the heavens and the earth and He is the Mighty, the Wise.
v.s: And to Him belongs [all] grandeur within the heavens and the earth, and He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
v.c: To Him belongs ˹all˺ Majesty in the heavens and the earth. And He is the Almighty, All-Wise.
